CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.ofTensorHom.{v, u} {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C] [MonoidalCategoryStruct C]
  (tensor_id : ∀ (X₁ X₂ : C), MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (𝟙 X₁) (𝟙 X₂) = 𝟙 (MonoidalCategory.tensorObj X₁ X₂) := by
    aesop_cat)
  (id_tensorHom :
    ∀ (X : C) {Y₁ Y₂ : C} (f : Y₁ ⟶ Y₂), MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (𝟙 X) f = MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft X f := by
    aesop_cat)
  (tensorHom_id :
    ∀ {X₁ X₂ : C} (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (Y : C), MonoidalCategory.tensorHom f (𝟙 Y) = MonoidalCategory.whiskerRight f Y := by
    aesop_cat)
  (tensor_comp :
    ∀ {X₁ Y₁ Z₁ X₂ Y₂ Z₂ : C} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (g₁ : Y₁ ⟶ Z₁) (g₂ : Y₂ ⟶ Z₂),
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (f₁ ≫ g₁) (f₂ ≫ g₂) =
        MonoidalCategory.tensorHom f₁ f₂ ≫ MonoidalCategory.tensorHom g₁ g₂ := by
    aesop_cat)
  (associator_naturality :
    ∀ {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : C} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃),
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom f₁ f₂) f₃ ≫ (MonoidalCategory.associator Y₁ Y₂ Y₃).hom =
        (MonoidalCategory.associator X₁ X₂ X₃).hom ≫
          MonoidalCategory.tensorHom f₁ (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom f₂ f₃) := by
    aesop_cat)
  (leftUnitor_naturality :
    ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y),
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (𝟙 (𝟙_ C)) f ≫ (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor Y).hom =
        (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor X).hom ≫ f := by
    aesop_cat)
  (rightUnitor_naturality :
    ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y),
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom f (𝟙 (𝟙_ C)) ≫ (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor Y).hom =
        (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor X).hom ≫ f := by
    aesop_cat)
  (pentagon :
    ∀ (W X Y Z : C),
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (MonoidalCategory.associator W X Y).hom (𝟙 Z) ≫
          (MonoidalCategory.associator W (MonoidalCategory.tensorObj X Y) Z).hom ≫
            MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (𝟙 W) (MonoidalCategory.associator X Y Z).hom =
        (MonoidalCategory.associator (MonoidalCategory.tensorObj W X) Y Z).hom ≫
          (MonoidalCategory.associator W X (MonoidalCategory.tensorObj Y Z)).hom := by
    aesop_cat)
  (triangle :
    ∀ (X Y : C),
      (MonoidalCategory.associator X (𝟙_ C) Y).hom ≫
          MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (𝟙 X) (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor Y).hom =
        MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor X).hom (𝟙 Y) := by
    aesop_cat) :
  MonoidalCategory C

`inferInstance` synthesizes a value of any target type by typeclass
inference. This function has the same type signature as the identity
function, but the square brackets on the `[i : α]` argument means that it will
attempt to construct this argument by typeclass inference. (This will fail if
`α` is not a `class`.) Example:
```
#check (inferInstance : Inhabited Nat) -- Inhabited Nat

def foo : Inhabited (Nat × Nat) :=
  inferInstance

example : foo.default = (default, default) :=
  rfl
